title: USCG Short; Air Station New Orleans rescue!
description:
U.S. Coast Guard Air Station New Orleans, in coordination with the Eighth Coast Guard District and U.S. Coast Guard Sector New Orleans, conducted a MEDEVAC off the construction vessel LEVIATHAN. The patient was quickly transported to Our Lady of Lourdes Regional Medical Center in Lafayette, LA. 
(Video by U.S. Coast Guard Air Station New Orleans)
